June 11, 2018 - By Michael Collier
Norris Perne & French Llp decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 13.88% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Norris Perne & French Llp sold 19,783 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 122,768 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $20.60M, down from 142,551 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Norris Perne & French Llp who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $942.23 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.91% or $1.76 during the last trading session, reaching $191.7. About 26.66M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 11, 2017 and is uptrending.
